description: This file defines the Gini impurity calculation and related classes for multiclass classification in Spark's MLlib. It includes the Gini object with calculation methods, GiniAggregator for updating statistics, and GiniCalculator for computing impurity from stored statistics.

classes.name: Gini
classes.description: Object for calculating Gini impurity during multiclass classification.

classes.name: GiniAggregator
classes.description: Class for updating views of sufficient statistics to compute Gini impurity for a sample.

classes.name: GiniCalculator
classes.description: Class for storing statistics and calculating Gini impurity for a specific (node, feature, bin).

methods.name: calculate
methods.description: Calculates Gini impurity for multiclass counts or throws exception for variance calculation.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of Gini impurity.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates statistics with a new label, number of samples, and weight.

methods.name: getCalculator
methods.description: Returns a GiniCalculator for given statistics.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the GiniCalculator.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the weighted count of data points.

methods.name: predict
methods.description: Predicts label based on the largest statistic.

methods.name: prob
methods.description: Calculates probability of a label given the stored statistics.
